title: Disabling a user does not seem to clear cross-signing keys.

labels.name: T-Defect
labels.description: Bugs, crashes, hangs, security vulnerabilities, or other reported issues.

labels.name: O-Uncommon
labels.description: Most users are unlikely to come across this or unexpected workflow

body:
### Description

The doc says that [disabling user clears the cross-signing keys](https://matrix-org.github.io/synapse/latest/admin_api/user_admin_api.html#deactivate-account).

But from my tests, the same cross-signing keys remain accross disabling+re-enabling process.

I even tested to trigger a `regenerate_directory` event and wait for it to complete before re-enabling it but it does change nothing.

Waiting for a fix, is there any workaround to manually clear (not replace, clear) cross-signing keys for a given user ?

Thanks by advance <3

### Steps to reproduce

- disable user via admin API
- enable user via admin APIh
- check for cross-signing keys (for ex in session initialization logs, but I guess it can be checked in DB too)


### Homeserver

private

### Synapse Version

SynapseVersion(server='1.88.0', python='3.11.4')

### Installation Method

Docker (matrixdotorg/synapse)

### Database

PostgreSQL

### Workers

I don't know

### Platform

Linux

### Configuration

_No response_

### Relevant log output

```shell
element-web JS console after deactivate/reactivate :


got cross-signing keys for @test3:xxx.yyy: 
Object { master: {…}, self_signing: {…}, user_signing: {…} }
bundle.js:2:3195419
```

(`…` being a complete key object, with hash remaining the same accross disable/enable cycles)

Although with a freshly created user, I get : 

```
got cross-signing keys for @test_j5:ouvre-boites.coop: 
Object { master: undefined, self_signing: undefined, user_signing: undefined }
bundle.js:2:3195419
```

Remains undefined accross logout/login cycles.
```


### Anything else that would be useful to know?

_No response_
